product_information.title: Indication
product_information.value: Piqray is indicated in combination with fulvestrant for the treatment of postmenopausal women, and men, with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with a PIK3CA mutation after disease progression following an endocrine-based regimen (see section 5.1 and for biomarker-based patient selection see section 4.2 of the SmPC).
